prediction_instruction: You are not answering for yourself. Predict how the respondent described in this request would answer. Use only the supplied information; do not invent personal experience, budgets or past behaviour.

notes: Evaluation and technical participants are disjoint; reserved categories are frozen and never reused.
A donor shares the study, category domain and coarse age/education cell, prefers the same gender, is never the recipient, and is used once.
Eligibility requires two products with three paired rounds each, one choice per round, all 29 fact items answered and all four background labels present.

request_estimate.basis: characters/4 plus a fixed per-request allowance; reconciled against the official usage report
